FUNCTION_BLOCK dw
VAR_INPUT
    i: INT;
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    o: INT;
END_VAR
VAR
    ss: INT := 0; // Internal state variable initialized to 0
END_VAR

// Function block execution logic
ss := ss + 1; // Increment internal state variable every cycle

IF i = 1 THEN
    o := 1; // Set output to 1 if input is 1
ELSE
    o := ss; // Set output to the current value of ss
END_IF;

END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

PROGRAM MAIN
VAR
    fb_dw: dw; // Instance of the function block
    input_value: INT := 3; // Input value for the function block
    output_value: INT; // Variable to store the output
END_VAR

// Call the function block with the input value
fb_dw(i := input_value);

// Retrieve the output from the function block
output_value := fb_dw.o;

END_PROGRAM
